name: Semantic-Aware Data Grouping (PG-SAG)
definition: A pipeline that partitions large-scale scenes into sub-groups based on semantic segmentation of buildings and geographic proximity, enabling parallel optimization of building regions.
summary: Semantic-Aware Data Grouping partitions 3D scenes into sub-groups by integrating semantic segmentation with geographic proximity, distinguishing itself from standard density-based clustering through its use of semantic priors.
